dimensions.assessment: Affects all federal political committees, political donors, payment card networks, and the Federal Election Commission.
dimensions.evidence: No political committee shall accept any internet credit or debit card contribution unless...

dimensions.assessment: Imposes strict donation verification requirements, changes disclosure rules by removing the $200 reporting threshold for contributions, and strengthens anti-straw-donation prohibitions.
dimensions.evidence: The bill removes a $200 threshold requirement for disclosing contributions, thereby requiring political committees to report identifying information about contributors, regardless of the amount contributed.

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for the FEC to promulgate regulations and consult with card networks, and compliance costs for political committees, but no direct federal spending authorization is provided.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Federal Election Commission shall promulgate regulations

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 across multiple sections regarding online contribution data, donor identification, gift card bans, threshold removal, and straw contribution prohibitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 302 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (52 U.S.C. 30102) is amended by adding at the end the following:

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory campaign finance compliance requirements for all future federal election contributions.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall apply with respect to contributions made after the expiration of the 90-day period

missing_information: Exact administrative implementation costs for the Federal Election Commission and affected political committees.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies federal campaign finance regulations by requiring CVC/CVV codes and billing ZIP codes for online political donations, restricting contributions from foreign addresses unless verified, prohibiting gift card donations, removing the $200 disclosure threshold, and banning assistance in making straw contributions.
